style: Paint a new card illustration in exactly the same art style as the reference images: the same clean, polished digital fantasy painting, smooth rendering, bold readable shapes, saturated colours, dramatic cinematic lighting and the same level of detail. The composition may be a portrait, a close-up or a scene with several figures, but it must stay coherent: one clear focal point, a setting that fits the subject, and no random or unrelated objects. Do not copy the reference subjects. Portrait orientation with the main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, numbers, logos, borders, card frames, UI icons or watermark.

cards.BU_BB: Rupture Brute: A hulking beast bursting out through a split cocoon wall, its hide cracking with red light, seen from a low angle so it looms over the viewer.
cards.BU_PH: Psi Hatchling: A nest of violet eggs in a glowing cave. One hatchling peeks out with huge eyes reflecting the viewer; faint silhouettes of siblings wait inside the other eggs.
cards.BU_SD: Scout Drone: A small drone peeking over a ridge at a distant enemy camp at dusk, its single green eye scanning.
cards.BU_SH: Scrap Hulk: A rusted giant rising out of a scrapheap, junk sliding off its shoulders, the furnace in its chest glowing.
cards.PW_BP: Bio Pulse: An organic seed-pod bursting, sending a ring of green bio-energy rolling over a group of creatures and cyborgs that recoil.
cards.PW_OS: Overload Strike: An armoured artillery cannon on treads firing a single overcharged red energy shell.
cards.PW_SB: Static Burst: Two robots locked in combat as a ball of static erupts between them, armour plates flying.
cards.RS_RF: Resource Fortification: A glowing energy crystal locked inside golden shield plates in a reinforced vault.
cards.BU_PI2: Patchwork Initiate: A young cyborg sitting up for the first time on an operating slab under surgical lamps, flexing a mismatched mechanical arm, stitches still fresh.
cards.BU_SM: Signal Mite: A wall of cables crawling with dozens of tiny spider-robots; one in the foreground stares straight at you with red eyes. Creepy surveillance.
cards.BU_AW: Assembly Wisp: A tiny floating ring-robot carrying a glowing armour piece through a vast, cathedral-like factory, motes of light in the air.
cards.BU_TN: Targeting Node: A tripod robot on a cliff edge painting a far-off enemy with green crosshair beams.
cards.BU_SL: Spore Larva: A close-up of a pale larva curled inside the ribcage of a long-dead giant, overgrown with glowing fungus, spores drifting like snow.
cards.BU_ML: Mind Leech: a disturbing alien brain parasite. A slick, segmented, half-translucent worm burrowed into the back of a host creature's skull, its hooked mouthparts sunk into exposed brain tissue, thin glowing filaments spreading under the host's skin like infected veins, the host's eyes rolled back and vacant, jaw slack. Wet, glistening, deeply unsettling body horror. Dim sickly violet and green light, heavy shadows, dark background. No magic effects.
cards.BU_BC2: Brood Carrier: A bloated insect mother squeezing through a narrow hive tunnel, seen from below, her back sac crowded with glowing eggs and larvae clinging to her legs.
cards.BU_RC: Relay Chimera: A creature–robot hybrid perched on a broken comms tower, antennae sprouting from its spine, cables and glowing nerves braided together.
cards.BU_FD: Fabricator Drone: A drone welding armour onto a robot's arm, the shower of sparks lighting both of them.
cards.BU_SH2: Scrap Harvester: A skeletal claw-robot with a glowing grinding maw, dragging wreckage through orange dust.
cards.BU_VS: Vector Sentinel: A guardian robot planting its tower shield at a fortress gate as a blue geometric barrier deflects incoming fire.
cards.BU_CA: Countermeasure Array: A heavy robot launching a fan of decoy flares and counter-missiles into the night sky.
cards.BU_RO: Railgun Overseer: A commander robot on a rampart firing its shoulder railgun in a blue streak while a line of robots marches below.
cards.BU_FT: Foundry Titan: A colossal robot with a forge in its chest, molten metal pouring as it hammers a weapon on its own anvil-arm.
cards.BU_GM: Grid Marshal: A robot commander standing over a glowing holographic battle map, tactical lines reflected across its armour.
cards.BU_SC2: Swarm Caller: A gaunt creature on a rock spire under a red moon, throat sac glowing, as a spiral of small winged creatures pours toward it out of the dark.
cards.BU_CS: Carrion Sprinter: A skeletal predator leaping over a fallen beast's carcass at full speed, with motion streaks across a dusk battlefield.
cards.BU_MA: Morphic Adept: A creature crouched at a still pool whose reflection shows a completely different form, with ripples of psychic light between the two.
cards.BU_CW: Chitin Weaver: A many-eyed, spider-like alien hanging in its lair from glowing silk, armoured cocoons of prey around it, its own plates half-woven.
cards.BU_HR: Hive Regent: a hive war-commander leading the charge. A large armoured insectoid beast with a crest of horns, scything forelimbs and a battle-scarred carapace, roaring at the front of a swarm of smaller creatures charging across a dusty battlefield. Grounded and combat-focused: no throne, no cathedral, no halo, no magical glow.
cards.BU_AA: Apex Aberration: a believable, grounded alien apex predator in mid-attack. A powerful, heavily muscled beast with an asymmetrical mutated body: its head split into extra jaws, irregular bony armour plates, scars and fresh tumorous growths, lunging forward with huge claws over a rocky alien battlefield, dust and debris flying. A physical creature that could really evolve, not a god: no magic, no glowing cosmic energy, no stars inside it.
cards.BU_SA2: Suture Architect: A surgeon-cyborg in a dim lab, many delicate arms stitching an armour plate onto a sedated creature with threads of light. Clinical and unsettling.
cards.BU_NI: Neural Interface: A close portrait of a cyborg with a glass skull, its brain wired into a crown of cables, eyes blazing as digital green and psychic blue light swirl.
cards.BU_AS: Alloy Symbiont: Liquid metal crawling up a cyborg's body like living armour, its mirror-chrome surface reflecting a nebula.
cards.BU_CE: Convergence Engine: A towering cyborg split down the middle (robotic half in green light, creature half in blue), meeting at a reactor heart, with a Robot and a Creature kneeling on either side.
cards.PW_EF: Emergency Firewall: A robot bracing behind a wall of hexagonal orange digital fire as a dark beam slams into it.
cards.PW_SP: Salvage Protocol: Robotic claws lifting a still-glowing reactor core out of a fallen robot under a single work light.
cards.PW_MA: Modular Assembly: An exploded view of armour modules snapping onto a robot frame, guided by blue schematic lines.
cards.PW_RC: Repair Circuit: A close-up of glowing green circuit lines knitting a crack in robot armour shut.
cards.PW_SJ: Signal Jam: The view through a robot's eye: the image torn by static and glitch bands, an enemy figure distorted.
cards.PW_M: Molting: A creature tearing free of its old shell inside a cocoon chamber, the husk splitting, a fresh glistening body emerging.
cards.PW_FE: Forced Evolution: A creature held in a column of psychic light, new limbs and plates sprouting, spirals of DNA-like light around it. Body horror.
cards.PW_CI: Cannibalistic Instinct: In shadow, a larger predator looms over a smaller ally with jaws open while glowing life energy drains across. Implied, not gory.
cards.PW_BR: Brood Recall: Small creatures crawling back out of a glowing pool of eggs and tendrils under a blood-red moon.
cards.PW_UC: Unstable Carapace: A creature whose shell is cracking with molten light, plates sliding as if about to burst.
cards.PW_C: Crosslink: A cyborg and a creature standing back to back, bound together by braided streams of light and cable.
cards.PW_ES: Emergency Separation: A Stack breaking apart in an explosion of sparks and torn cables, the two figures flung in opposite directions.
cards.PW_IN: Interference Net: A hexagonal energy net slamming down over a small robot, pinning it to the ground.
cards.PW_PS: Parasitic Snare: Parasitic tendrils erupting from the ground around a warrior's legs, draining glowing energy down into the dark.
cards.EQ_SH: Servo Harness: A hydraulic exoskeleton hanging on a workshop rack, a technician's silhouette fitting the last servo.
cards.EQ_AM: Adaptive Membrane: A jellyfish-like living membrane floating in a specimen tank, shifting through colours.
cards.EQ_IP: Interface Plating: Armour plates with glowing data ports bonding a cyborg's arm to a creature's shoulder.
cards.BU_CF: Carrion Foundress: An egg-filled matriarch with long reaching arms and a newborn crawling from her body, against crimson mist.
